summary: Iteration 7 review — Production Purge preview + safeguards, Fresh Production ZIP rebuild endpoint, jsPDF Installation Manual, and redesigned Delivery Center. All 12 pytest cases pass; all Playwright UI checks pass with zero console/page errors. Purge execute path deliberately NOT invoked (destructive).
critical_code_review_comments: production.py: preview response uses 'would_delete' (11 collections). Matches spec.
deliverables.py rebuild-zip: subprocess timeout=180s is tight for larger repos; consider 300s. Otherwise clean.

DeliveryCenter.js: doPurge uses window.prompt for phrase — meets spec. The Bearer token is read from localStorage('bc_token') and cookie credentials are used simultaneously; consider consolidating auth sources in a helper to avoid duplication (minor DRY note).

Preview endpoint counts 'counters' via db.counters.count_documents({}) but destructive path calls db.counters.delete_many({}) — semantically counters_reset shown in preview = number of counter DOCS, which is what will be deleted. Consistent.
seed_data_creation: None. Purge execute path intentionally skipped to preserve seeded data. Wrong-phrase purge attempt verified idempotent (preview counts identical before/after).
context_for_next_testing_agent: 12-test pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_iter7_delivery_purge.py covers: purge preview auth+PIN gating, purge wrong-phrase rejection (with before/after count parity), purge without PIN (401/403), deliverables manifest (5 sections incl. Production Release with valid download_url), rebuild-zip endpoint (returns ok+size_mb>0+log_tail), version/updates/receipts/students regressions. UI test using Playwright verified: Balaji FeeHub brand, /delivery-center with dc-install-manual, dc-purge-card, dc-purge-preview, dc-purge-execute, dc-purge-preview-panel, PIN prompt flow, and PDF download event with filename BalajiFeeHub-Installation-Manual-v1.0.0.pdf. DO NOT click dc-purge-execute in tests.
rca of the issue: No issues found. All flows behave as specified.
